findings.blocking_scope: Approval of the reusable reverse-map assembler; no current published edge loss observed.
findings.title: The assembler can silently lose an established transcript-video edge
findings.invariant: Every established source-to-video edge must be present in the reverse map, and reverse video IDs must be unique before constructing a dictionary.
findings.observation: The assembler checks that returned source IDs exist but never checks that every forward edge was retained. Its dictionary construction silently overwrites duplicate review IDs.
findings.counterexample: For eM8ZrqhZbgQ, delete VV-029 from the reverse row while retaining VV-030. The actual assembler accepts the input and writes 83 reverse edges against 84 forward edges. Appending a duplicate review row containing only VV-030 produces the same loss.
findings.current_data_impact: None observed: the frozen snapshot has 84 equal forward/reverse edges; VV-029 and VV-030 are both preserved.
findings.smallest_repair: Reject duplicate reverse video IDs before indexing. After applying reviewed forward corrections, compare the full set of (transcript_id, video_id) pairs in both directions and reject missing or unexplained extra edges before writing outputs.
findings.observer: observe_reverse_join.py baseline, missing_reverse_edge, and duplicate_reverse_id cases; baseline must pass, both mutations must be rejected.

findings.blocking_scope: Approval of automatic disposition for new unlinked candidates; current 41 decisions remain explicitly metadata-based.
findings.title: An unlinked upload is automatically assigned a no-transcript disposition before session ambiguity is resolved
findings.invariant: Absence of an exact upload-ID link does not establish absence of a supplied transcript; a same-principal/date candidate must stay unresolved until its recording relationship is reviewed.
findings.observation: Every admitted upload without an exact link receives No supplied transcript. Same-person source candidates are only appended as notes; they do not change the status. Current FoAy5Qfphcs handling works through an explicit hardcoded exception.
findings.counterexample: A synthetic new upload titled for Marco Fabián García Céspedes on 5 July 2019 is assigned No supplied transcript located for public-metadata session despite discovering VV-057 with that exact principal and date. No content evidence or source anchor supports absence.
findings.current_data_impact: No exact principal/date collision found among the 41 frozen metadata-only gap rows. This counterexample demonstrates a regeneration risk when admitting further uploads, not a proven false count among those 41.
findings.smallest_repair: Default an unlinked upload to Coverage unconfirmed. Promote it to an absence disposition only from an explicit reviewed session comparison. At minimum, generically retain same-principal/date ambiguities as unresolved instead of relying on hardcoded IDs.
findings.observer: observe_reverse_join.py unlinked_candidate case executes the actual builder loop in isolation. The synthetic candidate must not receive a no-supplied-source disposition without reviewed evidence.

invariants_checked: Distinct upload IDs and source IDs retain their many-to-many relation
Source transcript omissions and public recording omissions remain separate
Metadata-only and content-checked identity decisions remain visibly distinct
No-transcript claims require more than absence of an exact upload-ID link

mechanical_evidence.interpretation: The baseline passes; exit1 reports the deliberately reproduced invariant violations, not an operational failure.
mechanical_evidence.synthetic_outputs: observer_outputs contains isolated mutated projections and must not be presented as research data.

additional_content_observations.finding: Both support distinct recording/session identity relative to the supplied candidates. The Toro short recording is a procedural adjournment; its opening/title and closing automatic captions disagree by one day. The Solano recording is a questionnaire supplement, dated consistently 15 October 2019.

exclusions_and_limits: No new source-to-video link is asserted by the reviewer.
No independent audio listening; public automatic-caption anchors remain approximate.
The review does not certify 45 additional unique hearings or complete coverage of all supplied text.
Scope admission, channel freshness and spreadsheet rendering are reviewed separately.
No network requests or mutations of baseline, canonical files, shared caches or external resources were performed.
